messages:
Sam CSM: Quick sync — VelaBio wants to add two new teams (research + clinical ops) and run a real-time triage pipeline. They expect ~3x token throughput vs today and asked about Dedicated capacity, SSO, and predictable latency SLA. They also want a short pilot to validate latency <200ms 95th.
Priya AM: Nice signal. Any mention of timeline or budget? renewal window? :eyes:
Sam CSM: Timeline = next 6–8 weeks. No formal budget yet but they said they can move fast if we show predictable perf. Renewal isn't due for 9 months, so this is expansion-first.
Marta CS Ops: Important — do they plan to send PHI? Need to know for Private deploy / on-prem option.
Sam CSM: They said 'clinical ops' will include de-identified patient notes for triage, but might escalate to PHI later. For now it's de-id.
Luis SE: We can propose a short Dedicated pilot (4–6 weeks) with a small reserved pool + burst. Suggest we test with `redwood-llama-13b-quant` for perf/cost. Need current tokens/hour and peak concurrency.
Sam CSM: Current reported baseline from them: 
```
{
  "tokens_per_min": 18000,
  "peak_concurrent_sessions": 12,
  "avg_seq_len": 320
}
```
Kate AM: I'll prepare a preliminary commercial outline. If they triple tokens we should model cost delta and propose a reserved commit with a burst buffer. I'll need expected growth curve.
Priya AM: Renewal risk = low. This is expansion-led and increases stickiness. Main risk is if latency/regulatory needs aren't met.
Luis SE: Action: I can run a perf pass on staging with their prompt set. Sam — can you gather a ~200-prompt slice and a synthetic load script? I want to validate 95th <200ms and tokens/sec scaling.
Sam CSM: On it. I'll request prompts + attach a small seeding workload by EOD.
onboard-bot: Deployment request created: DR-4021 (staging perf job) — assigned to Luis SE.
Marta CS Ops: Also open a security intake for potential PHI handling. I'll start the intake doc and mark for Privacy review.
Kate AM: Tentative owners: Sam (customer prompts + kickoff), Luis (staging perf + test report), Kate (commercial outline/quote), Marta (security intake). I'll sync with Sales on Monday.
Priya AM: Good plan. Sam, please ping me after you get the prompt set so I can add to the account playbook. :thumbsup:
Sam CSM: Will do — scheduling kickoff meeting for next Monday. Thanks all.
